defmodule Orchestrator.ServiceAuth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for container orchestration"

  @hmac_secret System.get_env("ORCHESTRATOR_HMAC_SECRET") ||
                 raise("ORCHESTRATOR_HMAC_SECRET environment variable must be set")
  @token_ttl_seconds 300

  def generate_service_token(service_id, scope) do
    timestamp = System.system_time(:second)
    payload = "#{service_id}:#{scope}:#{timestamp}"
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_secret, payload)
    token = Base.url_encode64(payload <> "|" <> Base.encode16(signature))
    {:ok, token}
  end

  def verify_service_token(token, required_scope) do
    with {:ok, decoded} <- Base.url_decode64(token),
         [payload, sig_hex] <- String.split(decoded, "|", parts: 2),
         {:ok, sig_bytes} <- Base.decode16(sig_hex),
         expected_sig <- :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_secret, payload),
         true <- secure_compare(sig_bytes, expected_sig),
         [service_id, scope, ts_str] <- String.split(payload, ":", parts: 3),
         {timestamp, _} <- Integer.parse(ts_str),
         true <- System.system_time(:second) - timestamp < @token_ttl_seconds do
      if scope_satisfies?(scope, required_scope) do
        {:ok, %{service_id: service_id, scope: scope}}
      else
        {:error, :insufficient_scope}
      end
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false

  # A granted scope satisfies a required scope only when the granted scope is
  # equal to, or a hierarchical ancestor of, the required scope. That is, the
  # granted scope's parts must be a prefix of the required scope's parts.
  # (Broader grants cover narrower requirements, never the reverse.)
  defp scope_satisfies?(granted, required) do
    granted_parts = String.split(granted, ".")
    required_parts = String.split(required, ".")
    List.starts_with?(required_parts, granted_parts)
  end
end

defmodule Orchestrator.FileServer do
  @moduledoc "Serves configuration and deployment artifacts to authenticated services"

  use Plug.Router

  @base_path Application.compile_env(:orchestrator, :artifacts_path, "/opt/orchestrator/artifacts")

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  get "/api/v1/artifacts/*path" do
    with {:ok, token} <- extract_token(conn),
         {:ok, _claims} <- Orchestrator.ServiceAuth.verify_service_token(token, "artifacts.read") do
      requested_path = Path.join(path)
      serve_path(conn, requested_path)
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/configs/*path" do
    with {:ok, token} <- extract_token(conn),
         {:ok, _claims} <- Orchestrator.ServiceAuth.verify_service_token(token, "configs.read") do
      requested_path = Path.join(path)
      serve_path(conn, requested_path)
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  defp serve_path(conn, requested_path) do
    full_path = Path.join(@base_path, requested_path)
    resolved_path = Path.expand(full_path)

    unless String.starts_with?(resolved_path, Path.expand(@base_path)) do
      send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "access_denied"}))
    else
      case File.stat(resolved_path) do
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :directory}} ->
          send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "directory_listing_disabled"}))
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :regular}} ->
          send_file(conn, 200, resolved_path)
        _ ->
          send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not_found"}))
      end
    end
  end

  defp extract_token(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "authorization") do
      ["Bearer " <> token] -> {:ok, String.trim(token)}
      _ -> {:error, :missing_token}
    end
  end
end

defmodule Orchestrator.DiscoveryEndpoint do
  @moduledoc "Service discovery endpoint - unauthenticated for bootstrap"

  use Plug.Router

  @discovery_base "/opt/orchestrator/discovery"

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  get "/discovery/services" do
    case File.read(Path.join(@discovery_base, "services.json")) do
      {:ok, content} -> send_resp(conn, 200, content)
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 503, Jason.encode!(%{error: "discovery_unavailable"}))
    end
  end

  get "/discovery/topology/*path" do
    requested = Path.join(path)
    full_path = Path.join(@discovery_base, requested)
    resolved = Path.expand(full_path)

    if String.starts_with?(resolved, Path.expand(@discovery_base)) do
      case File.stat(resolved) do
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :regular}} when String.ends_with?(resolved, ".json") or String.ends_with?(resolved, ".yaml") ->
          send_file(conn, 200, resolved)
        _ ->
          send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not_found"}))
      end
    else
      send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "forbidden"}))
    end
  end
end
